Sources.Title: Zendesk Support API — official Postman collection ('Run in Postman' link, zendesk-public-api workspace)
Sources.AccessNotes: Web view (Collection Web View HTML) returns 200; the raw collection JSON export requires a Postman API key (api.getpostman.com/collections/{id} returned 401 AuthenticationError) which is out of scope for credential-free acquisition. Confirmed EXISTS and is vendor-maintained (part of the public 'zendesk-public-api' Postman workspace at postman.com/zendesk-redback/zendesk-public-api, which explicitly covers Support API + Help Center API, excluding Sell + Sunshine Conversations). Superseded in authority by the OpenAPI spec above, which is the same generator's source-of-truth and was fully retrievable. Retained as a secondary corroborating source for request/response shape spot-checks.

Sources.Title: Schedules API (Business Hours + Holidays) — prose reference, NOT present in the downloaded OAS
Sources.AccessNotes: 200 OK. IMPORTANT GAP IN THE OAS: this endpoint family (/api/v2/business_hours/schedules, .../holidays, .../intervals) is real, documented, and versioned (full CRUD) but is NOT included in the downloaded ticketing-oas.yaml (confirmed via grep — zero 'business_hours' matches outside 'deletion_schedule'). Zendesk's OAS generator has not yet migrated this endpoint family. Captured via prose docs as a Tier-1 OfficialDocs source; flagged in SOURCE_STUDY.md as an OAS-coverage gap, not a scope gap.
